name: sec-tables-pyodide-bridge
description: Typed Web Worker bridge that runs sec-tables 0.3.0 in Pyodide. No UI, no SEC networking.

scripts.pretest: npm run vendor && npm run build
scripts.//test:crossorigin: The whole app workflow again, with the API on another origin. A different port IS a different origin, so this exercises real preflights against the real proxy — the deployed Pages topology, minus TLS. Rebuilds same-origin afterwards so `npm run dev` is not left pointing elsewhere.
scripts.test:crossorigin: export SEC_TABLES_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:5310 && node tools/build.mjs && playwright test app cors; unset SEC_TABLES_API_BASE; node tools/build.mjs
scripts.test:live: PROXY_CMD="python3 tools/live_sec.py" SEC_LIVE=1 playwright test live
